status: PAPER TEST, not a live list
title: Paper test #3: Cash-Quality Compounders in an uptrend (CQC-D)
method: Steady cash compounders (profitable, FCF-positive, not diluting) trading above their 150- and 200-day averages. Universe: US-listed stocks over $2B with SEC us-gaap filings (870 stocks; 258 pass every rule), excluding financials, real estate, bitcoin miners and crypto-treasury companies. Percentile ranks are across that universe. Picks are the top 12 in score order with at most 3 per industry and 6 semiconductor/hardware names; the next 13 are backups. As backtested, picks are held for a quarter: weekly refreshes update the numbers, and the list is rebuilt at the quarterly rebalance (next: 2027-02-22).

rubric.component: Share count up less than 2% in 12 months
Profitable in at least 6 of the last 8 quarters

rubric.how: Ranked by cash quality: the average percentile of cash-based operating profit/assets, R&D-adjusted operating profit/assets, FCF/assets, low share issuance, EPS-up quarters and low accruals.

dataNotes: Fundamentals: SEC XBRL companyfacts, originally filed values, filings public by the 2026-11-23 close; quarters older than 230 days are ignored. Prices: Yahoo daily adjusted closes (month-end closes for the 10-month average, momentum and volatility; daily closes for the 150/200-day averages). Forward P/E, PEG, analysts and targets: StockAnalysis. Same code as the Nov 23, 2026 backtest harness.
backtest: Backtest 2012–Nov 2026: +0.5 to +0.7%/yr vs the same-universe equal-weight basket, Sharpe about 0.8, max drawdown about −30%; the only one of the three ahead of that basket in 2026. Least overlap with #1/#2 (27–35%). The 150/200-day gate is supported by 2012–26 data only; on 1975–2025 data plain cash quality did slightly better.
disclaimer: Paper test only (user-approved Nov 23, 2026): not a live list, nothing is traded, and the live screeners are unchanged. Backtests overstate future returns. Not financial advice.
